svg.title: iCertificates multi-agent pipeline
svg.desc: An email with a new ISIN triggers an AI Triage Agent, which fans out into three parallel agents: Quote Observation, KID Finder feeding a Scrape and Extraction Agent, and Certificate Status Refresh. All three feed a shared Staging Area. A scheduled QA and Data Promotion Agent moves data to a Production Area, and a scheduled Delivery Agent publishes it Live.
